title: Driver Bug
author: DaCringeyBaka
body:
### App DB report link

https://appdb.touchhle.org/apps/247

### App name

Driver

### App version

1.1.1

### touchHLE version

v0.2.2-868-g9141d98

### Operating system

Android 13

### GPU

Mali-G72

### What is the problem with the app?

Just tried running the now-recently-supported app on the latest trunk build on my Android phone, but upon the screen rotating, the game doesn't render anything, and it remains on a black screen. Please look into the issue ASAP.

Can confirm the same with 0.2.3 on S25 with Android 16. Game shows Gameloft logo then only sound works with black screen, When the app  loses focus it causes a  crash.

[touchHLE_log.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24495820/touchHLE_log.txt)

comments.author: ciciplusplus
comments.body:
Thanks for reporting!

This is a known issue on Adreno/Mali GPUs.

It is probably related to the OpenGL context sharing.
